# Test: Rollback from split-rootfs when controller connectivity is lost
# Scenario: monolith -> split (fully working) -> controller disconnect -> rollback
#
# This test verifies that Extension cleanup (unmount, verity close, file delete)
# works correctly when rollback is triggered while Extension is fully loaded
# and services are running. The rollback is caused by controller disconnect
# (Adam stopped), not by Extension failure.
#
# Flow:
#   1. Start on monolithic 15.11.0
#   2. OTA to good split image
#   3. Wait for Extension to fully load (services running, SSH available)
#   4. Stop Adam controller container
#   5. EVE detects controller unreachable → fallback timeout → reboot
#   6. EVE rolls back to monolithic 15.11.0
#   7. Restart Adam, verify rollback, verify Extension cleaned up
#
# Env vars:
#   EVE_VERSION  - split-rootfs EVE version tag (required)
#   EVE_REGISTRY - OCI registry path (default: lfedge/eve)

{{$eve_ver := "0.0.0"}}
{{$eve_registry := "lfedge/eve"}}

{{$env := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION"}}
{{if $env}}{{$eve_ver = $env}}{{end}}

{{$env_reg := EdenGetEnv "EVE_REGISTRY"}}
{{if $env_reg}}{{$eve_registry = $env_reg}}{{end}}

{{$eve_hv := "kvm"}}
{{$eve_arch := EdenConfig "eve.arch"}}
{{$short_version := printf "%s-%s-%s" $eve_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$test_info := "test eden.lim.test -test.v -timewait 30m -test.run TestInfo"}}

# Obtain the monolithic version we expect to roll back to
{{$mono_ver := EdenConfig "eve.tag"}}
{{$mono_hv := EdenConfig "eve.hv"}}
{{$mono_short := printf "%s-%s-%s" $mono_ver $mono_hv $eve_arch}}

# ── Step 1: Verify monolithic base ──────────────────────────
message 'Disconnect-Rollback: verifying monolithic base...'
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'monolithic'

# ── Step 2: Send OTA to good split image ─────────────────────
# Set short fallback-on-disconnect timeout (60s instead of default 300s)
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.test.baseimage.update=600
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.update.fallback.no.network=60

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: sending split image update...'
eden -t 10m controller edge-node eveimage-update oci://docker.io/{{$eve_registry}}:{{$eve_ver}}-{{$eve_hv}}-{{$eve_arch}} -m adam://
! stderr .

# ── Step 3: Wait for split to boot (inprogress) and Extension to load ──
# We wait for inprogress (not active) because we'll disconnect Adam before
# the testing window completes, so the update never reaches active state.
message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for split image to boot (inprogress)...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:inprogress InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $short_version }}'
stdout '{{ $short_version }}'

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for Extension services (SSH)...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for Extension mount...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

# Verify Extension is fully working before we disconnect
eden eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo mounted || echo not-mounted'
stdout 'mounted'

eden eve ssh 'ls /dev/mapper/exts-verity-* 2>/dev/null && echo verity-active || echo no-verity'
stdout 'verity-active'

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: Extension fully loaded, services running'

# ── Step 4: Stop Adam controller ─────────────────────────────
# This makes EVE lose controller connectivity. After 60s (our configured
# fallback timeout), nodeagent will trigger a rollback reboot.
# Before rebooting, it cleans up Extension (lazy unmount + delete).
message 'Disconnect-Rollback: stopping Adam controller...'
exec bash stop-adam.sh

# ── Step 5: Wait for rollback to monolithic ──────────────────
# EVE will detect controller unreachable → 60s fallback timeout →
# cleanup Extension → reboot → fall back to monolithic.
# We need Adam running to see the info messages, so restart it
# after a delay that gives EVE time to reboot.
message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for fallback reboot (90s)...'
exec sleep 90

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: restarting Adam controller...'
exec bash start-adam.sh

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for monolithic to become active...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:active InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $mono_short }}'
stdout '{{ $mono_short }}'

# ── Step 6: Wait for SSH and verify ──────────────────────────
message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for SSH...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: verifying rollback state...'

eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'monolithic'

eden eve ssh 'echo alive'
stdout 'alive'

# Extension from split partition should be cleaned up before rollback
eden eve ssh 'count=$(ls /persist/ext-img*.img 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "ext-img-count:$count"'
stdout 'ext-img-count:0'

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: SUCCESS - rollback with running services, Extension cleaned up'

# Reset config
eden eve reset

# Test's config file
-- eden-config.yml --
test:
    controller: adam://{{EdenConfig "adam.ip"}}:{{EdenConfig "adam.port"}}
    eve:
      {{EdenConfig "eve.name"}}:
        onboard-cert: {{EdenConfigPath "eve.cert"}}
        serial: "{{EdenConfig "eve.serial"}}"
        model: {{EdenConfig "eve.devmodel"}}

-- wait-ssh.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
    if timeout 10 $EDEN eve ssh echo ssh-ready 2>/dev/null; then
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 5
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "SSH not available after 150s"
exit 1

-- wait-extsloader.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 24 ]; do
    MOUNTED=$($EDEN eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo yes || echo no' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$MOUNTED" = "yes" ]; then
        echo "Extension mounted at /persist/exts"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "Waiting for Extension mount (attempt $((i+1))/24)..."
    sleep 10
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "Extension not mounted after 240s"
exit 1

-- stop-adam.sh --
echo "Stopping Adam controller container..."
docker stop eden_adam
echo "Adam stopped"

-- start-adam.sh --
echo "Starting Adam controller container..."
docker start eden_adam
# Wait for Adam to be ready
sleep 5
echo "Adam started"
